rule: Championship calendar order/date/event identity is static starting data.
Race results after career start are not authoritative for a new 1980 career.
Use period-correct display names for selected season while preserving stable track IDs.
Lap length and scheduled laps are starting-layout references; trait indexes are derived calibration.
Weather profiles are probability baselines, not real session weather.
Track grip/rubbering starts from a model seed and evolves inside each session.
Same Calendar/Circuit/Weather layer can be produced for any supported Season Database without replacing Main DB.
